placers.name: Talen Hall
placers.note: Class year HELD as incoherent, and the row's year cleared. The source's grade print derived class of 2029, which puts his 6A state appearance(s) in 7th or 8th grade; VHSL bars 8th graders from varsity, the rule that settled Teresa Fugal. Surfaced by the readiness gate's pre-freshman check when Virginia's qualifiers were minted on 4 Nov. He is a Class 1A state CHAMPION in both 2024 and 2025, which is what makes the year matter: under 2029 those titles fall in 7th and 8th grade, and VHSL bars 8th graders from varsity. His profile shows no bouts at all until this resolves - the only Virginia profile in that state. Needs the dated-record adjudication Fuller, Stone and Hamm got, whose stray 2027 turned out to be the in-season header-grade defect rather than evidence.

classYearUnresolved.note: RankWrestlers says class of 2028. She placed 5th at the 2024 VHSL girls championship, and VHSL Handbook 28-2-1 allows eighth graders on junior varsity only - no middle schooler reaches a VHSL state championship - so 2028 cannot be right. Her own record (state placements 2024, 2025 and 2026) fits class of 2026 or 2027 equally well and nothing on file separates them, so the year is held rather than guessed. Her profile keeps her three placements and gets a year when a family claim or a printed grade settles it. Her school was also corrected from the misspelling 'Albermarle', which was what kept her 2026 placement from reaching her profile at all (22 Oct 2026).
